review.scope: Controller constructor/Replace/manager/Peers/PeersInfo/HasPeer/DispatchEnabled/Forward source mapped to federation::Manager and Routes. Validation occurs before current links are changed; equal full Peer values retain their Arc/link/client, changed or removed links stop and publish disconnection, and old in-flight calls stay on old connections.
proof: replacement_preserves_unchanged_link_and_retires_only_changed_or_removed_peers directly checks retained Arc identity, credential rotation creates a new link, removed/old links are stopped, invalid duplicate replacement leaves the current two-link set untouched, and dispatch/unknown-peer floors.

Existing owner configuration integration exercises live replacement through actual hub methods, including authenticated-host-only administration, redaction, omitted/empty token semantics, invalid config nonmutation and removal. Existing reconnect and power-pause tests prove no automatic mutation replay.
intentionalDifferences: Parent approved retirement of the original Go component -peer name=...,url=...,token=... dev/test flag after source/recon and docs/deploy/script sweeps found no surviving shipped launcher depending on it. Rust uses workspacer serve --peers-file PATH (default config/peers.json), a JSON array of name/url/token/dispatch objects, with dispatch default false. Owner federation.peersConfig redacts token to hasToken; savePeersConfig preserves omitted token, clears explicit empty token and reloads changed links. Direct file edits apply at startup. docs/hub-federation.md now records this CLI exception; no new credential-in-argv parser is added.

Rust owns Manager task handles and joins shutdown rather than exposing a mutable Go busclient pointer. Routes clones preserve old connection ownership for in-flight calls; replacement closes changed/removed links instead of rerouting or replaying their calls. Explicit power-stop pause/resume is additive and tested separately; replacing peer metadata does not implicitly wake a stopped machine.

Forwarded JSON payload values are preserved semantically, including absent versus explicit-null fields and contradictory owner/provider facts. serde_json may reorder object keys or normalize whitespace; raw JSON lexical byte identity asserted by the Go RawMessage test is deliberately not promised. No federation model/window reconciliation occurs.

Topic allowlist is agent.* and workflow.*; already-stamped events are dropped, peer stamp is assigned only internally, and peer event ID is cleared for local broker allocation. This enforces one-hop propagation, not an acyclic network topology. Go private forwarded/dropped counters and exact connected-log wording are not a public contract; lifecycle events and PeerInfo remain observable.

Rust validates duplicate names and URL host presence before mutating links, preserves peer=1 despite pre-existing query parameters, and never derives destination host authority from link authentication. Production network fixtures require explicit credentials; old anonymous Go loopback harness startup is retired.

Remote worker launch now requires explicit Peer.dispatch=true, including ownerless forwarded agents.spawn. Go used dispatch only to enable return-channel stamping and permitted an unowned fire-and-forget spawn without it. Linked visibility and ordinary qualified reads remain independent of dispatch. This is the stronger owned execution opt-in boundary; tests must opt in before claiming to exercise destination routing.
review.validation: Root combined checkpoint: 372 library tests passed; the new destination-policy fixture failed before reaching its intended boundary; federation integration5 passed, including the complete semantic owner snapshot. Log /tmp/workspacer-recent-federation-collaboration.log also confirms exact unchanged-link identity regression passed. Corrected only fixture setup: disable both reviewer/deep_reviewer freshness at the permissive source (mode shifts count), and opt this peer into worker dispatch. The exact destination-policy regression then passed: 1 passed,0 failed,0 ignored,373 filtered out; /tmp/workspacer-federation-destination-fix.log. No new full-library green claim after those test-only corrections. Existing source-only policy regression had already passed the earlier full checkpoint.
